content:
Donald Trump continued his habit of flooding his Truth Social platform with bizarre AI-generated content on Monday, this time sharing two videos imagining UFC boss Dana White as his new White House press secretary.

The first clip, posted at 2 p.m. Eastern time, showed White strutting toward a lectern outside the White House and hyping up a massive crowd.

Some 23 minutes later, Trump shared another video, this time depicting White conducting a combative press briefing.

“All right, listen up. Everyone, sit down and shut up right now. I’m not answering questions until you show some respect,” the AI-generated White tells reporters in the clip.

When a journalist responds that “the public has a right to know,” the fake White fires back: “I said shut up. You’ll speak when I say so. Now sit down and be quiet or get out.”

The posts followed Trump’s suggestion over the weekend that White could replace his press secretary, an idea the president later walked back as a joke.

White subsequently appeared with Trump at a bizarre White House briefing on Monday, where he publicly turned down the role.
